kitchen-splashback-tiling-adelaide.html/.source: The wall-to-benchtop junction needs a suitable flexible joint detail where movement is expected. Rigid grout is not interchangeable with flexible sealant at that connection. The joint must be clean, prepared and compatible with the adjoining materials; applying a new bead over a failed or contaminated joint can leave the cause unresolved.
kitchen-splashback-tiling-adelaide.html/.target: 墙面与台面交界可能位移时，需要适当柔性接缝；此处刚性填缝不能替代柔性密封胶。接缝需清洁、处理并与相邻材料兼容。在失效或污染接缝上覆盖新胶，可能仍未解决原因。

kitchen-splashback-tiling-adelaide.html/.source: If a new benchtop leaves a gap beneath the old splashback, assess its size, exposed wall and surrounding tile condition before choosing a finish.
